svg.title: Scheduled RIPTA service near Rhode Island dialysis clinics
svg.desc: Tuesday November 17, 2026, 5–8 a.m. Highest: Providence (Plenty) (51). Lowest tied at zero: Fresenius Warwick, Westerly, Tiverton. All 16 supplied geocodes checked against CMS street addresses and state boundary.

g.text: Early bus service near dialysis clinics
Tuesday, November 17, 2026 · 16 CMS-listed in-center hemodialysis clinics
Scheduled bus trips stopping within 400 m of each clinic, Tuesday 5–8 a.m.
Dashed box on statewide map · same symbol colors
Fewest: Fresenius Warwick, Westerly and Tiverton, tied at 0
Scheduled arrivals ≥05:00 and <08:00; drop-off allowed; distinct trips after filtering.
400 m is straight-line distance, not walking distance. Supplied street geocodes, not entrances.
Sources: CMS listing + RIPTA GTFS, retrieved November 13, 2026; offline coordinate CSV.
Administrative boundary includes coastal waters; not a shoreline. Comparisons: detail table.
Scheduled service near clinics does not establish patient journey accessibility.
